title: Chain of Thought
description: An expandable summary of observable agent steps.
usage: Expand the summary to inspect search steps and linked sources. Replay reveals the scripted steps progressively.
keyboard: Tab to controls; Enter or Space to activate buttons.

title: Chat
description: A local conversation with an editable prompt and response actions.
usage: Send the suggested prompts to replay three scripted turns. Reasoning, commands and Markdown arrive progressively. Enter sends; Shift+Enter inserts a newline. Reset starts a new thread; Latest message returns to the live edge.
keyboard: Tab to controls; Enter or Space to activate buttons.

title: Checkpoint
description: Restore a saved point in a local conversation.
usage: Restore the conversation to the named checkpoint, then continue the sample conversation.
keyboard: Tab to controls; Enter or Space to activate buttons.

title: Confirmation
description: Review a proposed action and explicitly approve or deny it.
usage: Send the sample message, expand the reasoning, then approve or deny the proposed command. Reset repeats the local simulation. The demo does not execute commands.
keyboard: Tab to controls; Enter or Space to activate buttons.

title: Context
description: Inspect a conversation token budget.
usage: Hover or focus the context button to inspect the token budget and input, output and reasoning breakdown.
keyboard: Tab to the context button to open details; Escape closes them.

title: File Tree
description: Explore collapsible folders and inspect a selected file.
usage: Expand folders and select a file to inspect its path.
keyboard: Tab to controls; Enter or Space to activate buttons.

title: Inline Citation
description: An inline source reference with a hover and focus card.
usage: Hover, focus or activate an inline citation to inspect its source. Follow its link to open the original documentation.
keyboard: Tab opens the citation card; Escape closes it. Tab to the source link and Enter to follow.

title: Message
description: One turn, with a user bubble, Markdown reply and response actions.
usage: Copy the question or Markdown reply, edit the question, and toggle positive or negative feedback. Copy confirmation resets after two seconds. The reply is a fixed local sample.
keyboard: Tab to controls; Enter or Space to activate buttons.

title: Model Selector
description: Choose a sample model and a reasoning effort independently.
usage: Choose the model and effort from independent keyboard-accessible menus in the composer. Submit the local draft to see its text. These choices do not connect a provider.
keyboard: Tab between menus; Enter or Arrow Down opens a menu. Arrow keys choose an item; Enter selects it; Escape closes the menu.

title: Plan
description: Track a predefined plan and its completion count.
usage: Expand the plan and replay its steps to watch completion states change.
keyboard: Tab to actions and disclosures; Enter or Space activates them.

title: Prompt Input
description: Compose a message with attachments and a send button.
usage: Write a message, choose local files, remove attachments, and submit to see a local receipt. Files are not uploaded. Enter sends; Shift+Enter inserts a newline.
keyboard: Tab to controls; Enter or Space to activate buttons.

title: Queue
description: Separate remaining work from completed items.
usage: Expand pending and completed groups. Replay moves the scripted tasks through their statuses.
keyboard: Tab to actions and disclosures; Enter or Space activates them.

title: Reasoning
description: Stream a reasoning summary, expand its details and replay the response.
usage: Expand the reasoning summary or press Replay. Thinking text streams first, the summary closes automatically unless you changed it, then the answer arrives. Reduced motion disables decorative transitions.
keyboard: Tab to actions and disclosures; Enter or Space activates them.

title: Sources
description: Expand the source list and follow the original documentation links.
usage: Expand the source list and follow its original documentation links.
keyboard: Tab to actions and disclosures; Enter or Space activates them.

title: Stack Trace
description: Inspect an error and expand its stack frames.
usage: Expand the failed command and inspect application and framework stack frames. Replay repeats the sample failure.
keyboard: Tab to actions and disclosures; Enter or Space activates them.

title: Subagent
description: Inspect a delegated task, its sample tool calls and result.
usage: Expand the delegated task to inspect its reasoning, tool calls and result. Replay streams the local sequence.
keyboard: Tab to actions and disclosures; Enter or Space activates them.

title: Suggestion
description: Choose a prompt suggestion and inspect the selected local prompt.
usage: Choose a prompt suggestion or write your own message and submit it locally.
keyboard: Tab to actions and disclosures; Enter or Space activates them.

title: Task
description: Follow steps discovered as work progresses.
usage: Replay the sample to reveal discovered steps, running statuses and completion.
keyboard: Tab to actions and disclosures; Enter or Space activates them.

title: Terminal
description: Reveal sample command output one chunk at a time.
usage: Expand each command to inspect its own output. Replay streams output lines and updates command statuses.
keyboard: Tab to actions and disclosures; Enter or Space activates them.

title: Test Results
description: Inspect suites, test statuses and failure details.
usage: Expand the test run and its suites to inspect passing and failing tests. Replay progresses through the sample run.
keyboard: Tab to actions and disclosures; Enter or Space activates them.

title: Tool
description: Inspect a tool call with structured input and output.
usage: Expand command calls to inspect their outputs and errors. Replay runs the scripted sequence without executing commands.
keyboard: Tab to actions and disclosures; Enter or Space activates them.
